decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system remains tightly aligned with the firm's office and conference strengths and its move toward flexible workplaces, so it is still worth keeping unless demand now clearly disappoints.

After several years the floor cushions have likely revealed most of their value, and as a peripheral textile-adjacent line they no longer justify keeping the option open versus refocusing resources on core furniture and new development.
The high standing table is a close adjacent product for contemporary collaborative settings and can be carried at relatively modest risk, so it remains a sensible option to retain.
